title: THE UNSOLVED HEIST AT THE BACK OF A BAR

scenes.text: In 2020, thieves stole $17 million from a safe.
The criminals executed the heist in an underground vault.
Security footage captured the entire incident, yet no suspects have been identified.
This high-stakes crime remains a mystery.
Follow because some cases still need answers.

description: A $17 million heist executed within the depths of San Francisco left law enforcement baffled when no suspects were found. Discover the intriguing details behind this audacious crime. #shorts #truecrime #heist #SanFrancisco #fyp
